title: एक सिक्का डालो, दो पाओ… पर कुएँ ने बदले में क्या लिया? 😨
hook: इस कुएँ में एक सिक्का डालो, दो वापस आते हैं।

beats.text: इस कुएँ में एक सिक्का डालो, दो वापस आते हैं।
beats.scene: Extreme close-up of an old stone village well at night, a single silver coin glinting in moonlight as it falls into the black water, mist curling over the mossy rim, low camera angle.

beats.text: गाँव के साहूकार धनीराम के पास सबसे ज़्यादा पैसा था। फिर भी उसे और चाहिए था।
beats.scene: Medium shot of Dhaniram counting coins at a low wooden desk by lantern light in a cluttered room, cloth money bags and thick ledgers stacked around him, warm amber light.

beats.text: एक रात हिसाब करके लौटते हुए उसे पुराने कुएँ से किसी की आवाज़ आई।
beats.scene: Wide shot of Dhaniram walking alone down a misty village lane at night holding a lantern, the old stone well at the edge of a field behind him, moonlight through bare trees.

people.name: Dhaniram
people.expression: startled, turning his head toward the well

beats.text: आवाज़ बोली, जो डालोगे, उसका दुगना पाओगे। पर बदले में मैं तुम्हारी परछाईं का एक टुकड़ा लूँगा।
beats.scene: Medium shot of Dhaniram leaning over the rim of the well, a faint teal glow rising from deep inside it, his long lantern-cast shadow stretched across the stones behind him.

beats.text: धनीराम हँसा। परछाईं से किसका पेट भरता है? उसने एक सिक्का फेंका।
beats.scene: Close-up of Dhaniram's hand flicking a silver coin into the dark well, his face lit from below by the lantern, mist swirling around his wrist.

beats.text: पानी में छपाक हुई, और उसकी हथेली पर दो सिक्के चमक रहे थे।
beats.scene: Close-up of Dhaniram's open palm holding two gleaming silver coins, water droplets on them, the well's rim and teal glow softly blurred behind.

beats.text: उस रात उसने अपनी पूरी तिजोरी कुएँ में उलट दी। हर बार दुगना लौटा।
beats.scene: Wide low-angle shot of Dhaniram pouring a heavy cloth sack of coins into the glowing well, coins flying in an arc through the mist, moon high above, his shadow already thinner on the ground.

beats.text: सुबह गाँव वाले उसके पास से ऐसे गुज़रे, जैसे वहाँ कोई था ही नहीं।
beats.scene: Medium shot of a dusty village lane in pale morning light, Dhaniram standing in the middle holding out a coin while villagers walk past him without looking, soft mist at their feet.

beats.text: उसने धूप में नीचे देखा। उसकी परछाईं बस एक धागे जितनी बची थी।
beats.scene: High-angle shot looking down at Dhaniram standing in bright sunlight on the lane, his shadow only a thin faint line on the ground beside his feet, coins scattered around him.

people.name: Dhaniram
people.expression: frozen in dawning fear, staring down

beats.text: तब उसे समझ आया। कुआँ सिक्के नहीं बढ़ा रहा था। वह धनीराम को घटा रहा था।
beats.scene: Close-up of Dhaniram's face in the shade, his skin and kurta faintly translucent with the misty lane visible through his cheek, eyes wide.

beats.text: हर सिक्के के बदले कुएँ ने उसे थोड़ा मिटा दिया, जब तक लोग उसे देखना ही भूल गए।
beats.scene: Wide shot of the old well at dusk with a heap of shining coins beside it, the faint ghostly outline of Dhaniram sitting on the rim, almost invisible against the teal mist.

beats.text: आज भी आधी रात उस कुएँ से सिक्के गिनने की आवाज़ आती है।
beats.scene: Wide shot of the empty well under a full moon at midnight, drifting mist, a faint glint of coins at its rim and a soft teal glow from within, no one in sight.

cast.name: Dhaniram
cast.look: plump middle-aged Indian village moneylender with a thick black moustache, oiled side-parted hair, round wire spectacles, cream kurta under a brown waistcoat, a heavy gold ring

cast.name: Villagers
cast.look: ordinary Indian village men and women in simple faded cotton kurtas, saris and shawls, carrying baskets and water pots

description: एक लालची साहूकार को ऐसा कुआँ मिलता है जो हर सिक्का दुगना लौटाता है। पर हर सौदे की एक क़ीमत होती है।
